metadata.title: Onboard to Agentic Process Framework
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Systematically onboard a project to the Agentic Process Framework by identifying and creating all missing guidelines referenced by process steps. Use when first adopting the framework or when guideline folders are incomplete.

parameters.notes: This template has no parameters - it automatically scans the framework to identify all missing guidelines.

context.scope: Find all guideline files referenced in step definitions within process template directories and framework-steps/ that don't exist in ~/.claude/agentic-processes/guidelines
context.searchApproach: grep for userGuidelines in step JSON files within process template directories (templates/processes/*/*/*/*.json) and framework-steps/**/*.json, then check existence of each referenced path
context.outputFormat: Array of {path, guidelineName, category, referencedBy} objects

parameterMapping.guidelinePurpose: derived from step context that references it

actions: Use grep to find all 'userGuidelines' references in step JSON files within process template directories (templates/processes/*/*/*/*.json) and framework-steps/**/*.json
Parse each reference to extract the guideline path
Check if the file exists at the referenced path
Present findings to user for approval

step2BatchCreation.description: How to create guidelines in batch
actions: Read approved guidelines list from Step 1 output
For each guideline, spawn create-guideline sub-process
Use immediate sync - wait for each to complete before next
Handle any failures gracefully - continue with remaining guidelines
